name: Snohomish County, WA
findings: Snohomish County has 1,942 nonprofit organizations. 863 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 667 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Snohomish County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
